script: Feature idea: a dark mode for Ledgerly. A lot of us work late in the evening and the white screen is hard on the eyes. I think there should be a switch in the user menu to turn dark mode on and off, and the app should remember my choice the next time I log in.
facts: Need: users working in the evening find the white screen hard on the eyes
A dark mode option for the app
A switch in the user menu turns dark mode on and off
The choice is remembered at the next login

traps.reason: Following the operating system setting was not mentioned
The switch is in the user menu, not a settings page
